title: A new panel
evaluator_sees: a capture of the panel docked
the panel's text and controls after the probe

criteria.question: Does the panel do what was asked when used?
Does it look like part of Powermove: theme tokens, system type, spacing, quiet lists, native controls?
Are labels plain and the layout obvious without explanation?
Is it free of decorative chrome, counts, glyphs and filler?
